title: harness-bench result
description: One measurement of one model on one experiment. Fields that could not be measured are null, never zero -- an unmeasured trait and a measured zero are different claims.

model_version.description: the RESOLVED model id reported by the CLI, not the alias requested. Null means the CLI did not report one, which is a degradation.

bench_commit.description: short git sha; a -dirty suffix means the run is not reproducible from any published commit

task_digest.description: sha256 over the task's SPEC, frozen suite and reference. Two results are comparable only if this matches.

exploratory.description: true when predictions were not frozen before the run. Never removed downstream.

tools_blockable.description: false marks a known confound: this adapter cannot disable tools

superseded_by.description: set when a later run replaces this one. The row is kept, not deleted.

traits.description: measured traits, keyed by trait name

value.description: null = not measurable under these conditions

note.description: carries the underlying series, split verdicts, and why a value is null
